# Add fringe_adaptive and use AP → fringe_adaptive → grow → hill pipeline (as in best attempt_t1_b0_a2=1.0238)

The fringe_adaptive stage creates well-structured, boundary-optimized sets that grow can expand from effectively. Raw APs are distorted by aggressive grow expansion, which shift-only hill cannot recover from. By preprocessing with adaptive fringe (independent k_left/k_right), we provide grow with superior starting configurations, matching the mechanism that achieved 1.0238 and addressing the flaw in current 1.0161.
